{{Quote|No one's better at dueling than Varn!|[[Supreme Serpent Master]] [[Tyrann]] to [[Tanith Shire]]|<ref name="serpent" />}}
'''Varn''' was the [[Scout/Legends|chief scout]] of the [[Serpent Masters]], a group of [[Flying serpent|lizard]]-riding bandits that ruled the barren [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ophideraan]], and the right-hand man of [[Supreme Serpent Master]] [[Tyrann]]. A skilled rider of the Ophideraan flying serpent and the best duelist in his band of outlaws, Varn wore salvaged [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]].<ref name="serpent" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Varn captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Tanith Shire]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of the Serpent Masters who had been offworld working for the bandit gang. Skywalker and Shire conspired to overthrow the Serpent Masters, resulting in Varn being called in to battle with Skywalker in an aerial duel&mdash;however, Skywalker abandoned his fight with Varn to sabotage Tyrann's device that controlled the flying serpents, leading to the Serpent Masters' downfall.<ref name="serpent" />
